title: Amazon EKS 1.33 is past end of standard support
summary: Amazon EKS 1.33 reached the end of standard support on 2026-07-29 and is in extended support until 2027-07-29. Amazon EKS gives a minor version 14 months of standard support and then up to 12 months of extended support at an additional cost per cluster hour.

sources.title: Amazon EKS: Understand the Kubernetes version lifecycle

constraints: A control plane and its node groups are upgraded separately: raise the control plane before the node groups and the add-ons that pin a Kubernetes version.
Amazon EKS upgrades one minor version at a time, so cross each intervening minor version and read its upgrade notes.
A version past end of extended support is auto-upgraded, and a version in extended support is billed at the extended-support rate.

steps.title: Raise the cluster version
steps.instructions: Set cluster_version to the release in the replacement, then run terraform plan and apply the control-plane upgrade.

steps.title: Raise the node groups and add-ons
steps.instructions: Raise each aws_eks_node_group version and each managed add-on that pins a Kubernetes version so they match the new control plane.

steps.title: Remove APIs the new version deleted
steps.instructions: Read the Kubernetes deprecation guide for every minor version crossed and replace removed API versions in manifests and Helm charts before applying.

verification.purpose: Initialize without touching remote state and check that the configuration is valid.
Review the plan and confirm the control-plane and node-group changes are the intended ones.
Confirm the control plane reports the new version.
Confirm kubectl and the API server agree on the version.
